variants.prompt: Create concept A, 'Spirit seal', for the Legend of the Five Rings digital card game. Use the supplied screenshot as the exact aesthetic and placement reference, and the supplied twin-card medallion as the shape reference. Create a polished widescreen UI design study with a large close-up of the lower-left corner of a full card and a smaller real-size example on the dark blue table mat. Preserve all card artwork and the full rectangular card border; change ONLY the copy marker outside its lower-left corner. Icon and wisps occupy no more than 1.4 badge diameters outside lower-left; no full-card haze, no large particles, no swords, no new plaque. Avoid sci-fi cyan or neon. Create concept C, 'Dissolving seal', for the Legend of the Five Rings digital card game. Use reference screenshot for full-card UI context and reference twin-card round seal for shape.
